final_answer:
The overall AI-instrument pass rate across all 1,000 generated executive reports was **38.8%** (388 reports met or exceeded the ≥3.5 quality threshold). The prompt strategy that performed best was **S4 (One-Shot + BLUF)**, which achieved a **73.5%** pass rate.

The evidence explicitly states that of the 1,000 AI-generated reports scored against the four-dimension composite rubric, 388 (38.8%) met or exceeded the quality threshold [c5]. Regarding the best-performing strategy, Figure 1 in the evidence shows that Strategy S4 achieved a composite pass rate of 73.5%, which is significantly higher than all other strategies (S0: 61.0%, S2: 20.0%, S3: 38.0%, and S1: 1.5%) [c1].
